compiled_state.title: [reconciler:__main__]: reconcile-check stub returns list -> 'list' object has no attribute 'items'
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**Component:** plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/__main__.py:135-137 (_EmptyBindings stub)
**Condition:** Running `python -m dso_reconciler --mode reconcile-check` with applier module loaded
**Observed Result:** `ERROR: reconcile-check failed: 'list' object has no attribute 'items'`

**code_version:** a546556a5d5bb506b1f3eda18eb6bef9c93eebb8

## Reproduction

1. Run `python -m dso_reconciler --mode reconcile-check --repo-root $REPO_ROOT`
2. The error fires immediately

## Expected Behavior

reconcile-check reports discrepancies between local tickets and Jira issues.

## Actual Behavior

`ERROR: reconcile-check failed: 'list' object has no attribute 'items'`

## Root Cause

`__main__.py:133` checks `not hasattr(applier, 'BindingStore')` and falls through to a stub `_EmptyBindings` whose `all_bindings()` returns a list. But `BindingStore` is defined in `binding_store.py`, not `applier.py` — so the hasattr check ALWAYS fires and the stub is ALWAYS used. `reconcile_check.reconcile_check()` at line 235 calls `.items()` on the result, which crashes on a list.

## Suggested Fix

Replace the broken hasattr-based fallback with a direct load of `binding_store.py` using `load_binding_store(repo_root)` — the same pattern `reconcile.py:368` uses.

comments.body: Classification: mechanical (deterministic fix, no investigation needed — file lookup error)
